name: fzf
summary: General-purpose command-line fuzzy finder for interactively filtering and selecting items.

capabilities.label: fuzzy-find items from a list on stdin
traverse file system to list files
paste selected files onto command line
fuzzy completion for files and directories
fuzzy completion of process IDs for kill
fuzzy completion of SSH host names
preview highlighted item with a command
open in tmux or Zellij popup
display below cursor with set height
process ANSI color codes in input

fzf will launch interactive finder, read the list from STDIN, and write the selected item to STDOUT.
Without STDIN pipe, fzf will traverse the file system under the current directory to get the list of files.

fzf starts in "extended-search mode" where you can
type in multiple search terms delimited by spaces.
-e, --exact              Enable exact-match
-m, --multi[=MAX]        Enable multi-select with tab/shift-tab
Comes with integrations for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, Vim, and Neovim
`CTRL-T` - Paste the selected files and directories onto the command-line
`CTRL-R` - Paste the selected command from history onto the command-line.
`ALT-C` - cd into the selected directory

Fuzzy completion for files and directories can be triggered if the word before
the cursor ends with the trigger sequence
Fuzzy completion for PIDs is provided for kill command.
For ssh command, fuzzy completion for hostnames is provided.
### Environment variables / Aliases

For a command named _"COMMAND"_, define `_fzf_complete_COMMAND` function using
`_fzf_complete` helper.
--preview=COMMAND        Command to preview highlighted line ({})

With `--popup` option, fzf will start in a popup window
(requires tmux 3.3+ or Zellij 0.44+).
With `--height HEIGHT[%]`, fzf will start below the cursor with the given height.

--bind=BINDINGS          Custom key/event bindings
